articles.title: Dyson se proposer d'aspirer et laver en un seul passage avec le V15s Detect Submarine en promo à -33%
articles.text:
Le Dyson V15s Detect Submarine est un aspirateur balai qui aspire et passe aussi la serpillère, que vous retrouvez en promo à 589 euros au lieu de 879 euros sur Fnac.
Le Dyson V15s Detect Submarine marque l'entrée très attendue du constructeur britannique sur le marché des aspirateurs laveurs. Si l'on devait faire une analogie facile, nous dirions que Dyson est aux aspirateurs ce qu'Apple est aux smartphones. Un produit luxueux, haut de gamme, qu'on aime utiliser autant qu'afficher. Ici, il combine l'aspiration cyclonique du V15 avec une tête de lavage à l'eau claire. Comme tout appareil Dyson, son prix de base est onéreux mais il bénéficie de 290 euros de réduction sur Fnac, ce qui peut permettre de sauter plus facilement le pas.
Voici le Dyson V15s Detect Submarine à 589 € au lieu de 879 € sur Fnac
Pourquoi choisir le Dyson V15s Detect Submarine ?
- Pour son aspiration sans compromis typique de Dyson avec une puissance de 240 AW avec une brosse Optic Fluffy pour traquer la poussière invisible à l'œil nu.
- Le lavage efficace des tâches avec la brosse Submarine humidifiée qui vient à bout des tâches incrustées et liquides sur les sols durs.
- Son écosystème modulaire livré avec une pléthore d'accessoires pour passer du nettoyage d'une salle de bain à l'aspiration des poils d'animaux en un clic.
Un nettoyage hybride efficace qui se mérite
Si vous connaissez les Dyson, vous ne serez pas surpris de leur efficacité en aspiration, et ce modèle ne fait pas exception à la règle. Avec sa puissance de 12 500 Pa, il peut aspirer toute la poussière sur son chemin pour l'engranger dans son réservoir de 0,76 l. Ce n'est pas tout puisqu'il est doté d'une tête Submarine qui lave mais attention : elle peut faire l'un ou l'autre, pas les deux en même temps. Et il faut avoir une petite condition physique pour le manier parce qu'il est quand même 4,1 kg et qu'il faut garder en permanence le doigt sur la gâchette. Il est quand même silencieux en mode lavage, avec 60 dB mesurés, ce qui contraste avec l'autonomie de ses petits réservoirs (300 ml d'eau propre) qui imposent des allers-retours fréquents au robinet. Il se destine avant tout aux profils avec des surfaces dures, de taille modérée (environ 40m²) qui ont l'habitude d'aspirer avant de passer la serpillère.
Une approche modulaire face aux aspirateurs tout-en-un
Contrairement aux aspirateurs laveurs massifs comme le Dreame H12 Pro, ce modèle Dyson apporte de la polyvalence en conservant le format passe-partout et les accessoires dédiés d'un aspirateur balai premium : un suceur long, une brosse Digital Motorbar, une mini brosse motorisée auto démêlante et la station murale qui va avec. C'est juste dommage qu'il ne sache pas aspirer et laver en même temps, et que son autonomie ne fasse pas un peu de progrès : 60 minutes en mode Eco, une poignée de minutes en mode Boost. Et il n'y a pas de station d'auto nettoyage, donc ça implique un entretien de votre part.
✅ Les points forts
- Sa puissance d'aspiration de 240 AW sur tous les types de sols
- Son lavage qui vient à bout des tâches aussi bien fraîches qu'incrustées
- Sa polyvalence avec sa panoplie complète d'accessoires
- So niveau sonore maîtrisé et agréable en mode lavage de 60 dB
❌ Les limites
- Impossible d'aspirer et laver en même temps avec la brosse Submarine
- Ses réservoirs d'eau sous-dimensionnés qui poussent à des remplissages fréquents
- Un collecteur d'eau sale mal conçu qui fuit si la brosse est inclinée
- Son poids important et le maintien de la gâchette obligatoire
- Un seul rouleau fourni
L'aspirateur balai laveur Dyson V15s Detect Submarine est bradé à 589 € sur Fnac
Le Dyson V15s Detect Submarine est une bonne affaire si vous êtes fan de la marque et que vous cherchez un modèle capable de ponctuellement laver en profondeur les sols de vos petites pièces. C'est l'outil idéal pour centraliser le matériel d'entretien au sein d'un appartement ou pour un ménage par zone de la maison.
Si vous avez de grandes surfaces carrelées à traiter en une seule passe, les petits réservoirs d'eau vont rendre l'expérience trop fastidieuse. Et un dernier conseil pratique : pensez à bien transporter la brosse Submarine à l'horizontale jusqu'à votre évier : le bac d'eau sale étant ouvert, il risque de fuir s'il est trop incliné quand vous le manipulez.

articles.title: Cómo se verían Las Guerreras K-pop en el universo de Dragon Ball Super: Beerus
articles.text:
El estreno de Dragon Ball Super: Beerus abre una posibilidad para que los seguidores del anime imaginen a Las Guerreras K-pop dentro del universo de Goku y Vegeta.
Con referencias visuales y un pedido preciso, una herramienta de inteligencia artificial (IA) puede crear una escena de combate que enfrente al grupo con Beerus en un escenario espacial.
El procedimiento puede realizarse desde un navegador actualizado, sin instalar archivos de origen desconocido ni programas externos que soliciten permisos innecesarios.
Cuál es el primer paso para recrear imágenes de Las Guerreras K-pop
El primer paso es reunir una imagen grupal de Las Guerreras K-pop donde se distingan los rostros, los peinados, las prendas y los accesorios de cada integrante.
Una toma de cuerpo entero o desde la cintura permite que el generador identifique mejor las diferencias entre las protagonistas y reduzca la posibilidad de repetir caras o mezclar los vestuarios.
Además, se debe tener una referencia de Beerus, Goku y Vegeta. La imagen debe mostrar elementos reconocibles de cada personaje, como las orejas y el atuendo del Dios de la Destrucción, el uniforme naranja de Goku y la armadura de Vegeta.
Si la escena incluirá transformaciones, conviene que las referencias ya exhiban el cabello azul y las auras de energía correspondientes.
Qué plataforma permite generar imágenes con IA
Las imágenes pueden adjuntarse en el chat de Gemini, la herramienta de inteligencia artificial de Google. El acceso se realiza desde el sitio oficial mediante un navegador actualizado, una alternativa que evita instalar aplicaciones desde páginas no verificadas o archivos cuyo origen no se puede comprobar.
Dentro de la conversación, los archivos se incorporan con el botón de adjuntar o al arrastrarlos hacia la ventana del chat. Es preferible enviar las referencias de Las Guerreras K-pop y de Dragon Ball en un solo mensaje. De ese modo, la herramienta recibe el conjunto visual antes de interpretar la instrucción.
Antes de avanzar, se debe revisar que las miniaturas se vean completas. Una imagen borrosa, un recorte que elimine parte del vestuario o la presencia de figuras ajenas pueden modificar el resultado y dificultar que cada personaje conserve sus rasgos.
Cómo debe redactarse el prompt para la IA
El texto debe indicar el estilo de animación, los personajes, sus ubicaciones y el tipo de enfrentamiento. Las imágenes de referencia permiten conservar la apariencia general, mientras que el prompt define la acción.
Un ejemplo de pedido es: “Crear una ilustración de acción estilo anime. Tres guerreras K-pop inspiradas en las referencias visuales enfrentan a Beerus, Goku y Vegeta en un planeta destruido. Ubicar a las guerreras a la izquierda y a Beerus a la derecha, con Goku y Vegeta detrás. Mostrar plano panorámico, escombros flotando, expresiones de combate y destellos de energía”.
La instrucción puede sumar datos para distribuir los ataques. Por ejemplo: “Beerus concentra una esfera violeta en la mano derecha; Goku usa una energía azul; Vegeta avanza con el puño cerrado; una guerrera sostiene una espada, otra forma un escudo de energía y la tercera prepara dagas luminosas”.
Asimismo, la ambientación requiere elementos propios de la saga para que el cruce tenga coherencia visual. Un cielo oscuro con galaxias, cráteres, ruinas, rocas suspendidas y explosiones de ki pueden situar a las protagonistas en una batalla similar a las de Goku y Vegeta contra adversarios de gran poder.
Qué hacer antes de descargar y compartir la imagen
La primera generación debe revisarse por partes. Es común que la IA produzca manos con dedos adicionales, armas deformadas, ojos desalineados, accesorios repetidos o personajes que aparecen en un lugar distinto al indicado. Puede confundir el cabello de una integrante con el aura de otro peleador.
Las correcciones funcionan mejor con órdenes breves y puntuales. Se puede pedir: “Mantener tres guerreras”, “corregir la mano izquierda de Beerus”, “eliminar el brazo duplicado de Goku”, “ubicar a Vegeta detrás de Goku” o “hacer que la guerrera de cabello trenzado conserve su chaqueta amarilla”.
Una vez elegida la versión final, el archivo puede descargarse desde la misma conversación. Antes de compartirlo en redes sociales, mensajes o una publicación, hay que aclarar que se trata de una imagen creada con inteligencia artificial y de una recreación realizada por usuarios, sin vínculo oficial con las producciones originales.

articles.title: Go Issues Emergency Update Blocking Eight CA Keys Over Undisclosed Security Concerns
articles.text:
Go 1.27.3 and Go 1.26.10, released on October 20, make Go's certificate verifier reject any certificate chain that passes through one of eight intermediate certificate authority keys.
Programs built on the new release will refuse connections to sites and services whose certificates were issued under those keys. The Go team says the keys belong to one certificate authority it has not named, and that it is blocking them because of "specific security concerns around their operation."
It handled the fix on its URGENT track, the one reserved for its most serious issues, and recommends upgrading immediately.
Two days earlier, on October 17, Mozilla added six intermediate certificates issued by eMudhra's emSign Root TLS CA - G3 to OneCRL, the list Firefox uses to block certificates. The Mozilla bug behind those entries is closed to the public, and neither Mozilla nor Go has said what prompted its action. Whether Chrome, Apple, or Microsoft have taken similar action is not established.
Go's change lists only the SHA-256 hashes of the eight keys. A commenter on the Go issue matched all eight to eMudhra intermediates by looking the hashes up in certificate records.
By that matching, six are TLS intermediates issued under the same emSign Root TLS CA - G3 that Mozilla's entries name, and two are code-signing intermediates under emSign Root CS CA - G3:
- TLS, domain validated: EM DV TLS CA - G3B (eMudhra BV, Netherlands) and EM DV TLS CA - G3C (eMudhra Inc, U.S.)
- TLS, organization validated: EM OV TLS CA - G3B and EM OV TLS CA - G3C
- TLS, extended validation: EM EV TLS CA - G3B and EM EV TLS CA - G3C
- Code signing: EM OV CS CA - G3B and EM OV CS CA - G3C
The Hacker News has not independently checked the hashes against the certificates. Mozilla's six entries carry the same issuing root, but Mozilla's records do not name the six certificates.
The filter runs whenever a Go program verifies a certificate chain. It hashes each certificate's public key rather than the certificate itself, so a cross-signed copy of one of the eight keys, the same key signed by a different root, is caught as well.
It is applied in Go's own verifier and in the macOS and Windows code paths that hand verification to the operating system. A rejected chain returns the error x509: no valid chains built.
The change contains no setting to turn the filter off. Given the structure of the code, it also applies when a program supplies its own set of trusted roots, so a private deployment that intentionally trusts one of the eight keys will fail too. The Go team has not said whether that is intended.
Go's verifier "doesn't do any revocation checking," as its documentation warns. It also does not read the block lists browsers use, such as the CRLSets Chrome used against rogue Google certificates this month.
Blocking a key therefore means shipping it in a release, and programs keep the old behavior until they are rebuilt. Projects including Bluesky's indigo were rebuilt on the new releases on October 20.
What happened at the certificate authority is not public. Go's announcement gives one sentence about security concerns, and the release came without the pre-announcement Go sent before its October 8 security releases.
Go's security policy defines URGENT track issues as "a threat to the Go ecosystem's integrity" or flaws being actively exploited with severe damage, and says there are no recent examples. Go has not said which of those applied.
On the issue, one user asked for the committed patch to explain "who and what they correspond to." The Go team had not replied as of October 20.
eMudhra is an Indian certificate authority that sells certificates under the emSign brand. Its roots emSign Root CA - G1 and emSign ECC Root CA - G3 are in the Chrome, Apple , and Mozilla root stores. The company told Mozilla earlier this year that its newer TLS root is cross-signed by emSign Root CA - G1, which is how certificates under the newer root chain to a trusted root.
In September, a six-week public discussion of eMudhra's request to add ten new roots to the root programs run by browser and operating-system makers, including emSign Root TLS CA - G3, closed with no objections.
Certificates logged for eMudhra's own domains, including emsign.com and emudhra.com, chain through other eMudhra intermediates, according to certificate transparency records The Hacker News checked on October 20. The company's repository contained no notice about the intermediates as of that day, and The Hacker News found no public statement from eMudhra.
Go 1.25 and older releases are out of support and get no fixes, so the only route is a supported release from the download page. No temporary workaround exists in any source, and the filter cannot be disabled.
Sites and services whose certificates chain through the eight keys will need certificates from a different intermediate before rebuilt Go clients can connect to them.

articles.title: The newest AdGuard VPN update makes catching discounts and toggling connections faster than ever
articles.text:
The newest AdGuard VPN update makes catching discounts and toggling connections faster than ever
Hands-free Siri commands, widget controls, and smarter website exclusions to your daily browsing.
- AdGuard VPN's v2.17 update improves both iOS and Android platforms simultaneously.
- iOS users get revamped Shortcuts, allowing one-tap connections, Home Screen widgets, and Siri voice commands.
- Android users can now spot promotional discounts directly inside the app, while both platforms benefit from expanded non-Latin script domain exclusions.
AdGuard has just launched version 2.17 of its virtual private network app, and this time, the privacy company is taking a unified approach.
For the first time, the release rolls out simultaneously for both iOS and Android devices. Moving forward, the provider says it will "keep updates for both platforms in sync to bring you key features and improvements faster."
For iPhone and iPad users, the standout feature is a revamped Shortcuts integration that lets you control your secure connection with just one tap or a simple voice command.
Meanwhile, Android users are getting a streamlined way to snag cheaper subscription deals, alongside improved split-tunneling exclusions for international websites across both operating systems.
Speeding up your connection on iOS
If you regularly toggle your VPN on and off to use local services, the process can quickly become tedious.
As AdGuard points out in its official release post, jumping between your privacy tunnel and restrictive local services can be a chore: "You start the day with AdGuard VPN on. Then you need it off for a few minutes to check your bank account, so you open the app, tap Disconnect, open the banking app, close the banking app, open the AdGuard VPN app again, and tap Connect."
To bypass this daily annoyance, version 2.17 introduces improved Shortcuts for iOS. Users can now place a Connect, Disconnect, or Toggle button directly on their Home Screen or within their phone's Control Center.
You can even set up background automations to ensure the VPN turns itself on the moment you open a specific application or connect to an unfamiliar public Wi-Fi network.
If tapping a widget is still too much effort, the update also brings full Siri integration to the table. By diving into the app's settings menu, you can record custom voice triggers, such as "Hey Siri, connect to AdGuard VPN", to control your privacy completely hands-free.
While we noted in our latest AdGuard VPN review that the service had room to grow against industry giants, quality-of-life updates like these certainly push it in the right direction.
Smarter exclusions and easier savings
While Apple users get the flashy widgets, the Android camp hasn't been entirely left out.
Finding a good deal on a digital privacy subscription usually requires hunting through promotional emails or constantly refreshing a provider's website. Now, AdGuard VPN will display active promotions and discounts directly on the purchase screen inside the Android app.
Finally, the v2.17 update brings a highly requested technical tweak to both the iOS and Android platforms. AdGuard's Exclusions feature, which allows you to choose which websites automatically bypass the encrypted tunnel, now fully supports domains written in non-Latin scripts. This means users can seamlessly whitelist domains like *.рф for Russia and *.中国 for China without the application returning an error.
The version 2.17 update is available to download right now. If you spot any bugs, the provider encourages users to submit feedback directly through its social media channels or via its GitHub repositories.

With over two decades of experience as a reporter and editor, he specializes in making complex topics like cybersecurity, VPNs, and enterprise software accessible and engaging.

articles.title: Le Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 se faufile partout pour faire le ménage : pour moins de 550€ vous êtes tranquille
articles.text:
Le Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 est un aspirateur robot laveur qui s'occupe de vos sols pour vous laisser du temps libre, que vous pouvez avoir contre 549,99 euros au lieu de 889,99 euros jusqu'au 25 octobre 2026.
Le Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 est un aspirateur robot laveur plutôt classé dans le haut de gamme, qui s'occupe donc de la poussière mais aussi des tâches, avec ses serpillères. Il est livré avec une station multifonction qui est plutôt massive, ce n'est pas un modèle discret, mais ça permet d'automatiser son entretien, ne vous laissant que le strict minimum à faire. Vous lui déléguez l'entretien des sols, comme ça vous avez du temps libre pour faire autre chose, et en plus vous le payez moins cher avec la réduction actuelle sur Amazon puisqu'il perd 38% de sa valeur.
Voici le Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 à 549,99 € au lieu de 889,99 € sur Amazon
Pourquoi choisir le Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 ?
- Pour sa finesse extrême avec son LiDAR rétractable qui réduit sa hauteur globale à 7,98 cm, ce qui lui permet de se glisser sous les meubles, canapés et lits inaccessibles aux autres modèles.
- Sa grande capacité d'aspiration de 25 000 avec un bras mécanique FlexiArm qui garantit des sols durs impeccables et des angles parfaitement dépoussiérés.
Un nettoyage automatisé pour les grands espaces
Le Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 est un aspirateur robot laveur comme on peut en trouver beaucoup sur le marché, qui se démarque par sa puissance d'aspiration brute de 25 000 Pa. Elle est couplée au système intelligent DirTect qui détecte optiquement le niveau de saleté au sol pour adapter instantanément l'intensité des passages. Le fait qu'il puisse soulever ses patins de 12 mm sur les moquettes ou relever l'intégralité de sa brosse principale sur une trace de liquide fait qu'il passe facilement d'une surface à l'autre chez vous. C'est un appareil fait pour les habitations de grande surface ou si vous possédez des animaux, puisqu'il a une brosse faite pour ça. Il peut enchaîner 160m² de nettoyage et ne pas être gêné grâce à sa brosse DuoDivide.
Face au Qrevo Curv 2 Pro, un choix de raison
Le Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 est plus fin que la concurrence, et son rapport qualité/prix avec la promotion du moment fait qu'il est vraiment intéressant. Mais il montre sa limite technique sur le franchissement des seuils : il ne peut pas grimper plus de 2,5 cm. Là où le Qrevo Curv 2 Pro peut allègrement grimper des obstacles de 4 cm d'épaisseur. Un de ses compromis majeurs qui le rend moins adapté aux logements anciens qui ont d'importantes barres de seuil surélevées entre chaque pièce.
✅ Les points forts
- Son format fin de 7,98 cm pour passer sous les meubles bas
- Le bras FlexiArm pour le nettoyage des angles et le suivi des plinthes
- La puissance d'aspiration de 25 000 Pa avec la brosse anti enchevêtrement DuoDivide
- La station multifonction autonomie avec lavage, séchage et vidange automatisés
- La gestion des poils d'animaux et des tapis avec le relèvement de 12 mm des patins
❌ Les limites
- Le franchissement des seuils limité à 2,5 cm
- La détection d'obstacles par IA perfectible sur les petits objets du quotidien
- La station d'accueil est assez volumineuse
- L'absence de réservoir interne dédié au détergent
Jusqu'au 25 octobre 2026, le Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 est à 549,99 € au lieu de 889,99 €
Le Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 est un appareil qui permet d'automatiser le ménage chez vous, avec des caractéristiques premium et une traque de la saleté le long des murs pour un tarif bien maîtrisé, surtout avec la promo chez Amazon. Il s'adresse directement à celles et ceux qui veulent un appareil qui passe tout seul. Vous le programmez pour qu'il passe plusieurs fois par semaine ou vous le faites intervenir sur une tâche qui vient de se faire et vous allez gagner un temps fou.
Par contre si votre logement est très compartimenté, avec des seuils de portes qui sont haut, il faudra passer sur un modèle à châssis élévateur sinon vous n'arrêterez pas d'avoir des messages d'erreur. Et un petit conseil avant de craquer : pensez à lui réserver une belle place chez vous, car pour pouvoir stocker sa station de charge, il faut anticiper ce besoin précis.

articles.title: La puce Nvidia RTX Spark affronte les Apple M5 Pro et M5 Max sur la création 3D et vidéo
articles.text:
Nvidia RTX Spark : que vaut la partie graphique de la puce qui veut révolutionner l’informatique, Nos résultats labo
Les PC portables équipés de la plateforme RTX Spark sont désormais disponibles. Nous poursuivons notre évaluation de la puce N1X, en nous attaquant cette fois-ci à son processeur graphique (GPU). Tests synthétiques, applicatifs ou encore gaming : nous avons tout passé au crible.
Après avoir détaillé l’architecture de la puce N1X dans un premier article, puis évalué les performances de son processeur (CPU) dans un second, ce troisième volet se consacre à la partie graphique. Pour l'occasion, nous avons éprouvé le GPU à travers nos benchmarks habituels, nos logiciels de création (3D, photo et vidéo) et l'intégralité de notre protocole de test dédié aux PC portables gamers.
La partie GPU du N1X : une RTX 5070 bridée
Sans revenir en détail sur l'architecture globale, le point essentiel à retenir est que la puce N1X embarque 6 144 cœurs CUDA, un nombre identique à celui d'une GeForce RTX 5070 pour PC de bureau (et non sa version mobile). Nvidia a toutefois concédé deux compromis : la quantité de cache L2 est divisée par deux (24 Mo contre 48 Mo pour la RTX 5070 de bureau) et la bande passante de la mémoire unifiée est réduite (300 Go/s contre 672 Go/s).
En revanche, la N1X possède un avantage majeur face aux cartes dédiées traditionnelles : sa mémoire. La puce peut être configurée avec un accès allant jusqu'à 128 Go de mémoire unifiée, là où une RTX 5070 se contente de 12 Go de VRAM. Si cette quantité astronomique n’impacte pas les performances graphiques brutes, elle change la donne pour l'intelligence artificielle. Elle permet de stocker et d'exécuter localement de gigantesques modèles d’IA (comme des équivalents de ChatGPT), sans connexion internet ni abonnement, garantissant ainsi une confidentialité totale des données.
Nous vous rappelons que pour évaluer cette plateforme, Nvidia nous a fourni un PC portable Asus ProArt P16 équipé de cette puce N1X à 20 cœurs (6144 unités CUDA), le tout épaulé par 64 Go de mémoire vive. Nous avons activé le mode Performance (Fn+F) comme nous le faisons avec tous les PC portables gaming afin d'évaluer le plein potentiel de la puce.
Asus ProArt P16 (RTX Spark 20c)
Les performances théoriques
Pour mesurer la puissance brute, nous nous sommes appuyés sur le test GPU de Geekbench 6.5. Habituellement, nous privilégions l’API la plus adaptée à chaque écosystème (Metal pour Apple, OpenCL pour AMD). Cependant, l'API CUDA de Nvidia n'étant supportée qu'à partir de Geekbench 7, la puce RTX Spark a dû se contenter d'OpenCL sur la version 6.5, ce qui nous permet tout de même de la comparer aux puces concurrentes.
Malgré cette contrainte, les 6 144 unités CUDA permettent à la RTX Spark de dépasser une GeForce RTX 5070 mobile (TGP 100W) d'environ 10 % sur le calcul GPGPU. Elle reste toutefois à distance de la puissante RTX 5080 du Razer Blade 16 (2026), qui la devance de 30 %. Face à la concurrence directe d’AMD et la partie graphique Radeon RX 8060S intégrée au Ryzen AI Max 395, la solution de Nvidia se montre écrasante, avec 61 % de performances supplémentaires.
Contre Apple, et malgré l'utilisation d'une API OpenCL non optimisée pour Nvidia, la N1X réussit l'exploit de surpasser la puce M5 Pro (qui tourne pourtant sous son API native Metal), mais reste logiquement distancée par le mastodonte M5 Max et ses 40 cœurs GPU. À titre indicatif, le passage à Geekbench 7 permet d'activer l'API maison CUDA. Le score bondit alors de 120 674 (OpenCL) à 190 079 points, soit un gain faramineux de 64 % !
Les applications créatives
Nos trois logiciels de référence (Blender, Photoshop et Premiere) permettent de jauger la puce en conditions réelles. Comme souligné lors de notre test CPU, l'écosystème Adobe reste globalement bien mieux optimisé sur Mac que sur Windows, même face à des GPU surpuissants.
- Premiere Pro : La RTX Spark fait jeu égal avec la RTX 5070 (100W) du Framework 16. La puce M5 Pro d'Apple conserve une légère avance en rendu (1 min 42 contre 2 min 01 pour Nvidia), tandis que la M5 Max survole le test en 1 min 06. La puce AMD ferme la marche en 2 min 58.
- Photoshop : Même sur la version Beta d'Adobe CC, la puce N1X ne se démarque pas particulièrement sur les tâches classiques. Son véritable atout réside dans l'exécution des outils boostés à l'IA (comme la suppression intelligente d'objets), qui s'exécutent en un clin d'œil grâce aux cœurs Tensor.
- Blender : Outil open source par excellence, Blender tire pleinement parti de l'architecture RTX. Notre scène Barcelona est rendue en 34 secondes, battant d'une courte tête la M5 Pro (36 s). La M5 Max reste intouchable (25 s), tandis qu'AMD est largement distancé en raison d'une prise en charge logicielle moins aboutie.
Gaming : la limite de l'émulation
Évaluer la RTX Spark en jeu constituait un défi de taille : notre panel de jeux étant intégralement codé en x86, la puce ARM de Nvidia doit s'en remettre à l'émulation Prism de Windows.
L'analyse de nos sept titres de référence met en lumière deux tendances claires. Dans les jeux plus anciens ou très exigeants pour le processeur (comme Shadow of the Tomb Raider, Assassin’s Creed Mirage ou Returnal), le GPU ne parvient pas à s’exprimer, particulièrement en 1080p. Dans Returnal, activer le DLSS pour soulager la carte graphique ne fait pas monter le framerate : la puce passe son temps à attendre les données du CPU, ralenti par la couche d'émulation.
En revanche, sur des titres lourds graphiquement où le GPU est le seul maître à bord (Alan Wake 2, Forspoken, Black Myth: Wukong), le goulot d'étranglement du CPU disparaît. La RTX Spark dévoile alors son véritable potentiel, se positionnant légèrement au-dessus d'une RTX 5070 mobile (100W). Dans ce cas de figure, elle surpasse largement la Radeon RX 8060S d'AMD, l'écart se creusant d'autant plus lorsque les jeux exploitent les dernières technologies Nvidia (DLSS 4 et Frame Generation).
Bilan : un potentiel à convertir
La puce N1X au cœur de la plateforme RTX Spark est un véritable tour de force technologique de la part de Nvidia. En intégrant l'équivalent d'un GPU de bureau de milieu de gamme dans un format unifié à très haute capacité de mémoire, le constructeur redéfinit ce que l'on peut attendre d'une puce intégrée.
Pour les créatifs, c'est un outil redoutable : elle offre des temps de rendu 3D excellents et talonne les puces Apple Silicon sur certains logiciels. Espérons qu'Adobe fasse évoluer au mieux sa suite pour profiter pleinement des fonctionnalités de la puce avec des versions natives de ses logiciels et surtout une meilleure prise en charge des capacités logicielles de la puce.
Côté gaming, le bilan est plus nuancé, mais plein de promesses. La puissance graphique pure est indéniablement présente, rivalisant avec de solides cartes dédiées comme la RTX 5070 mobile. Cependant, son architecture ARM la rend tributaire de l'émulation x86. Si elle brille sur les jeux AAA très gourmands en ressources GPU (surtout épaulée par le DLSS 4), elle se heurte encore aux limites de l'émulation processeur sur les titres qui sollicitent massivement le CPU. En définitive, la RTX Spark n'est pas qu'une simple puce : c'est la première pierre d'une révolution de l'architecture PC, qui ne demande plus qu'à voir l'écosystème logiciel (et notamment les jeux) adopter nativement l'ARM pour libérer son plein potentiel.
De notre côté, il nous reste à évaluer les performances de la puce RTX Spark dans son domaine de prédilection : l'IA locale. Nous avons réuni la concurrence et établi un protocole afin de comparer de la manière la plus objective qui soit les performances dans ce domaine.

articles.title: WhatsApp quiere que los stickers tengan audio: así se podrá agregar una grabación
articles.text:
WhatsApp prueba una función que permitiría agregar sonido a los stickers que se comparten en los chats, con grabaciones de voz o archivos de audio de hasta 10 segundos.
El hallazgo lo hizo Android Authority, que logró activar la función en una versión de prueba para Android identificada como v2.26.41.11. El sitio publicó capturas del proceso de creación y un video que muestra los stickers con sonido funcionando dentro de una conversación.
Cómo se agregaría el audio a los stickers de WhatsApp
Al crear un sticker a partir de una fotografía, aparecería un ícono de ondas de sonido en la barra de herramientas. Al tocarlo, la aplicación ofrecería dos opciones: grabar la voz en el momento o elegir un archivo de audio guardado en el teléfono.
El límite para esa grabación o archivo sería de 10 segundos. Si el audio elegido dura más, la herramienta permitiría recortarlo antes de incorporarlo a la imagen, de modo que el usuario pueda ajustar qué fragmento acompaña al sticker.
Una vez enviado, el sticker mostraría un ícono de volumen para indicar que tiene sonido asociado. Al tocarlo dentro del chat, se reproduciría el audio adjunto, según describió Android Authority tras probar la función en su dispositivo.
Esto responde a una de las preguntas centrales sobre la novedad: la función de sonido en los stickers de WhatsApp consiste en poder adjuntar una grabación de voz o un archivo de audio de hasta 10 segundos a una imagen, que luego se reproduce al tocar el sticker dentro de la conversación.
El sitio WABetaInfo, que también había detectado este desarrollo, agregó que el sonido respetaría el modo silencioso del teléfono y que existiría la posibilidad de silenciar el audio de manera manual, una preferencia que se mantendría para los siguientes stickers que se reproduzcan.
Stickers animados y otros cambios en desarrollo
Para los stickers animados creados a partir de videos, la prueba conserva de forma automática 5 segundos del sonido original del archivo. El usuario también tendría la opción de reemplazar ese audio por una grabación propia o por otro archivo almacenado en el teléfono.
De esa manera, un sticker animado podría mantener tanto el gesto visual como la frase o el sonido que lo acompañó originalmente, o bien sustituirlo por un audio distinto elegido por quien lo crea.
Android Authority encontró, además, un ajuste adicional dentro de la misma pantalla de creación: un interruptor para activar o desactivar el borde que WhatsApp agrega de forma automática a los stickers. Hasta ahora, ese contorno se incluía sin posibilidad de quitarlo.
Según WABetaInfo, el proyecto contempla también la llegada de paquetes de stickers con sonido a la tienda de la aplicación, en paralelo a las creaciones que hagan los propios usuarios con sus fotos y videos.
Android Authority señaló, por su parte, que WhatsApp trabaja en un cambio en la apariencia del cuadro de redacción de los chats. En la actualidad, ese campo ocupa una sola línea y concentra a la derecha los íconos de adjuntos, cámara y otras funciones.
La versión en desarrollo mostraría un cuadro de dos líneas, con esos íconos ubicados en la línea inferior y la línea superior despejada para escribir el mensaje. El medio no precisó el motivo del cambio, aunque no descartó que responda a la incorporación futura de más funciones en esa barra inferior.
Cuándo llegarán estas novedades a WhatsApp
La función de stickers con sonido no está disponible para el público ni para los usuarios que participan en las versiones beta de la aplicación. Tampoco cuenta con una fecha de lanzamiento anunciada por parte de Meta, la empresa dueña de WhatsApp.

articles.title: Russian APT28 Breaches NATO Naval Shipbuilder in NATO Country, Deploys New Reflective Loader
articles.text:
The Russia-linked state-sponsored threat actor tracked as APT28 (aka BlueDelta, Fancy Bear, and Forest Blizzard) has been attributed to attacks targeting two member states of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO).
The Symantec Threat Hunter Team, which is tracking the activity cluster under the moniker Swallowtail, involved the use of a backdoor called HOOKEDGE and a previously undocumented loader that is designed to decrypt and run an encrypted payload in memory by using a cryptographic key that's supplied at runtime.
Targets of the activity included a law enforcement agency, a naval shipbuilder, and a manufacturer of military aircraft engines – entities that hold information that could be of use to a foreign intelligence agency, the Broadcom-owned threat intelligence unit said.
"During one attack against the naval shipbuilder, operators returned to a compromised host repeatedly over the course of a week in what appeared to be hands-on-keyboard activity," Symantec said in a report shared with The Hacker News. "They stole credential material using two separate techniques, opened a persistent SSH tunnel into the organization's internal network and deployed a previously undocumented reflective loader."
APT28's use of HOOKEDGE was first publicly documented by Recorded Future Insikt Group in late August 2026 in connection with a cyber espionage campaign targeting government and diplomatic organizations in Romania, Spain, and Türkiye between September 2025 and early April 2026.
HOOKEDGE shares significant code and tradecraft overlap with HEADLACE, a modular Windows implant that APT28 has put to use in attacks targeting diplomats since April 2023. Delivered via spear-phishing lures, HOOKEDGE is a barebones Windows batch script that's capable of accepting attacker-issued commands and sending the results back.
The backdoor is delivered via macro-enabled Microsoft Word documents and communicates entirely through a webhook[.]site URL, which acts as a channel to stage tasks and to receive execution output. Infected machines then fetch these tasks using a hidden, off-screen instance of the Microsoft Edge browser as opposed to relying on a traditional downloader.
In the attack aimed at the naval shipbuilder in late July 2026, the threat actors are said to have delivered new variants of HOOKEDGE that abandon the use of webhook[.]site in favor of a dedicated IP address ("185.82.218[.]119:443") for both tasking and exfiltration.
"The attackers used two distinct credential-theft techniques," Symantec said. "In one, they pushed an SSH private key onto the compromised host and immediately used it to open an SSH connection back to their own server, requesting a persistent, backgrounded tunnel that would give them a route from their infrastructure into the target's internal network."
"In the other, they ran a short, self-contained PowerShell script that stands up a listener on the host's own loopback address and forces the machine to authenticate to it, capturing the resulting NTLM handshake."
The attackers have also been observed dropping a new reflective loader ("ld.exe") using a curl command via SSH that's engineered to decode and run a next-stage component. The exact nature of the payload remains unknown.
The most recent activity was registered on September 24, 2026, when a Visual Basic Script launcher associated with HOOKEDGE was observed within the shipbuilder's network. It's unclear if any data was stolen as a result of these intrusions.
"The tradecraft observed after initial access, credential theft through two independent techniques, a persistent network tunnel, and a previously undocumented loader, goes beyond the delivery mechanism that has so far been publicly reported on this campaign," Symantec said.
Attacks Targeting Ukraine in H1 2026
In a report published late last month, the Computer Emergency Response Team of Ukraine (CERT-UA) revealed that Russian hackers are increasingly targeting the smartphones belonging to Ukrainian military personnel and government officials for espionage and financially motivated attacks.
"The growing role of smartphones in communications among military personnel, government employees, and civilians is making them more attractive targets for intelligence gathering activity, further compromise, and financially motivated attacks," the agency said.
This includes the use of the DarkSword iOS exploit kit, which is distributed via watering-hole attacks through compromised legitimate Ukrainian news outlets and government sites to siphon sensitive data from compromised devices.
"The tool is associated with Russian threat actors, and its use against Ukrainian targets points to the adversary's growing interest in the iOS platform, which had previously been considered relatively secure," the agency noted.
The findings are consistent with a report from Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) in March 2026, which linked the Russian espionage actor UNC6353 to the use of Coruna and DarkSword kits in watering-hole campaigns targeting Ukrainian users since summer 2025.
The threats also extend to the Android ecosystem, with threat clusters UAC-0244 and UAC-0263 using decoy apps to deliver two different malware families -
- UAC-0244 distributes CAMELSPY, which harvests device system information, geolocation, SIM card details, contacts, call logs, and images from the gallery.
- UAC-0263 distributes BTMOB RAT, which gives the threat actor control over the infected device and the ability to exfiltrate data.
CERT-UA also said it observed APT28 exploiting vulnerabilities such as CVE-2026-21509, a security feature bypass in Microsoft Office, and CVE-2026-8496, a zero-click vulnerability in the SOGo webmail client, to deliver the COVENANT malware as well as siphon victims' mailbox credentials and data, respectively.
"At the same time, the actor has not abandoned older, tried-and-tested – but unfortunately still effective – approaches," CERT-UA said. "In particular, attacks exploiting XSS vulnerabilities in the Roundcube webmail client were observed. Excel documents containing macros were also used to further distribute COVENANT."
These attacks are among the 3,137 cyber incidents recorded by CERT-UA in the first half of 2026, which is estimated to be 8% more than in the second half of 2025.
The development comes as Team Cymru said it identified five additional LegionRelay command-and-control (C2) servers used in attacks targeting Ukrainian entities. The IP addresses are listed below -
- 91.149.221[.]118:8000
- 91.149.221[.]123:8000
- 166.88.239[.]54:8000
- 194.87.108[.]12:8000
- 194.87.108[.]217:8000
LegionRelay is the name assigned to a PowerShell-based RAT that supports file enumeration, file exfiltration, screenshot capture, browser data theft, Telegram and WhatsApp data exfiltration, and RDP access setup. It's attributed to a threat actor dubbed GREYVIBE, which is assessed to have engaged in persistent attacks targeting Ukraine and Ukraine-related entities since at least August 2025.

articles.title: NAS vs external hard drive: What are the differences?
articles.text:
NAS vs external hard drive: What are the differences?
We compare storage capacity, speed, pricing, and backup features
Network-attached storage (NAS) and external hard drives are effective ways to store and access large files on the go.
Yet, many sometimes need help when choosing between NAS systems and external hard drives. You’ve arrived at the right place if you fall into this category. We've tested the best NAS drives, NAS devices, and external hard drives.
So, I’ve written this guide explaining what you should know about NAS systems and external hard drives before deciding.
NAS vs. External Hard Drive: Design
Network-attached storage (NAS) utilizes hardware, software, and data transfer protocols to let users share files over a network. It uses a NAS box that houses storage disks, processors, and a random access memory (RAM) unit. This box has specialized software to manage file storage and user access.
NAS boxes can connect to a network and let users share files seamlessly. Suppose you work in a company with 50 staff. All 50 staff can connect to a single NAS box to access organizational files. Think of the NAS system as an online tree where everyone can pluck information. It provides an easy way to share massive files between employees.
In contrast, external hard drives are standalone devices that transfer files over USB ports rather than a network. Every file is stored locally, and the hard drive must be plugged into the PC that wants to retrieve information from it.
NAS systems offer substantially more storage space than external hard drives. You can always expand the storage capacity of your NAS system by adding more drives, unlike external hard drives with fixed storage capacities.
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
External hard drives are portable and easy to move. Employees can quickly pass them around to retrieve relevant files, but this process gets cumbersome for large workforces. Picture a 100+ workforce sharing a single external hard drive; that’s inefficient and weakens productivity.
In contrast, you can keep a NAS box stationary, and employees can connect to this box from their respective PCs. Everyone can access files seamlessly without looking for hard drives to plug into their PC. A NAS system is the most convenient option for businesses that can afford it.
NAS vs. External Hard Drive: Price
NAS systems are more expensive than external hard drives, expectedly, because they use more sophisticated components. A NAS system includes a storage box, networking components, and a processor to run the software.
In contrast, an external hard drive’s main component is a simple magnetic disk (platter) that stores data. NAS systems are more expensive to produce.
A 4 TB external hard drive costs an average of $90. Meanwhile, a 4 TB NAS system costs upwards of $200. It gets costlier when more drives are added to the existing setup. When weighing both, expect to spend more on a NAS system, but the trade-off is bigger storage capacity and the convenience of accessing files.
NAS vs. External Hard Drive: Speed
NAS systems offer excellent speed, although they depend on bandwidth. Consumer-level NAS devices have average data transfer speeds of 3 to 20 MB per second (Mbps), but high-level NAS devices can reach 100 to 200 Mbps. Because they depend on network bandwidth, data transfer speeds can be slow when many people connect to the same NAS box.
External hard drives transfer data via USB ports. Data transfer speeds depend on the USB version of your external hard drive. USB 1 offers up to 12 Mbps, USB 2 offers up to 480 Mbps, USB 3 reaches up to 5 Gbps, and USB 4 has a maximum speed of 40 Gbps.
Some NAS systems offer gigabit speeds (over Ethernet cables) comparable to USB. On average, USB systems have faster data transfer speeds. However, I think this shouldn’t matter much because most users don’t transfer files at gigabit speeds. Both NAS and hard drives are sufficient for everyday use.
NAS vs. External Hard Drive: Backup and Redundancy
Many NAS systems have built-in data backup features. For instance, you can back up a Synology DS923+ NAS to Google Drive. You can schedule automatic backups, wherein all data stored on the Synology NAS box will be uploaded to Google Drive daily, weekly, or monthly. Automated backups keep your data safe even if the NAS device fails.
In contrast, external hard drives don’t have built-in backup software. To back up files, you need to manually connect the drive to a PC, which is cumbersome. People often forget to do manual backups, but automated NAS backups solve this issue. Your data is safer on a NAS than on a hard drive.
NAS vs. External Hard Drive: Verdict
NAS systems offer much larger storage and are expandable. They offer a more convenient way to access data, making it the best choice for enterprises. NAS systems cost more than external hard drives, but the higher cost is worth the convenience for business users.
External hard drives are ideal for casual users who frequently transfer files between PCs. They handle large file transfers without issues, although the process isn’t as smooth as using a NAS system. I think the hassle and expense of setting up a NAS system aren’t worth it for casual users.

articles.title: Xiaomi 18 Pro et Pro Max : les prix fuitent et rendent l'iPhone 18 Pro Max finalement pas si cher
articles.text:
Attention au portefeuille, ça risque de piquer. Les Xiaomi 18 Pro et 18 Pro Max devraient être annoncés prochainement en Europe. Leur prix de départ pourrait titiller celui des modèles d'Apple, quitte à le dépasser.
Xiaomi a présenté ses smartphones 18 Pro et 18 Pro Max en Chine le mois dernier, deux smartphones qui se distinguent notamment par leur autonomie, en plus de leur écran dorsal. Alors que leur lancement international se fait toujours attendre, des informations récemment divulguées apportent des précisions sur leurs caractéristiques, mais aussi sur le prix en Europe.
Des batteries revues à la baisse par rapport à la version chinoise
Des fiches publiées sur le registre européen EPREL (European Product Registry for Energy Labeling) révèlent les capacités des batteries prévues pour les versions européennes de ces deux appareils. Le Xiaomi 18 Pro serait ainsi équipé d'une batterie de 6 000 mAh, tandis que le 18 Pro Max disposerait d'une batterie d'une capacité de 7 050 mAh.
Ces capacités restent inférieures à celles annoncées pour les modèles commercialisés en Chine. Elles restent toutefois convenables pour des smartphones haut de gamme.
- Design toujours réussi
- Un objectif principal très lumineux
- Les performances dingo
D'après ces mêmes fiches, le Xiaomi 18 Pro pourrait offrir une autonomie allant jusqu'à 66 heures et 30 minutes, contre 70 heures et 40 minutes pour le Pro Max. Ces chiffres correspondent à des estimations issues de tests standardisés. Les deux smartphones seraient par ailleurs dotés de batteries garanties pour conserver 80 % de leur capacité d'origine après 1 000 cycles de charge.
Un tarif en Europe très élevé ?
C'est sur le plan tarifaire que ces informations suscitent des interrogations. Toujours selon le rapport cité, le Xiaomi 18 Pro pourrait être proposé à partir de 1 449 euros pour la version 256 Go, et à 1 649 euros pour la version 512 Go. Le Xiaomi 18 Pro Max, dans sa configuration 512 Go, serait quant à lui annoncé à 1 849 euros.
À titre de comparaison, le prix d'un iPhone 18 Pro en version 256 Go est de 1 479 euros, soit trente euros de plus. Idem pour le tarif d'un iPhone 18 Pro Max en version 512 Go, dont le tarif devrait être attendu à 1 879 euros. Cependant, Xiaomi ne semblerait pas proposer de version 256 Go de son 18 Pro Max.
Ainsi, l'appareil le moins cher de la gamme, 1 849 euros dépasserait le tarif de départ de 1 629 euros demandé pour un iPhone 18 Pro Max.
Une proposition qui devra convaincre
L'autonomie élevée promise par ces deux modèles pourrait séduire les utilisateurs cherchant à limiter la fréquence de charge de leur smartphone. Cependant, le positionnement tarifaire du modèle Pro, proche de celui du Xiaomi 17 Ultra, pourrait inciter les acheteurs à patienter davantage.
Ces prix européens restent pour l'instant non confirmés par Xiaomi. S'ils venaient à se vérifier, la marque devrait démontrer que ses nouveaux modèles haut de gamme justifient ce positionnement tarifaire. En effet, les alternatives à des prix inférieurs ne manquent pas.
Contrairement à la marque à la pomme, Xiaomi est cependant adepte des promotions de lancement, pouvant parfois atteindre plusieurs centaines d'euros. Si les tarifs indiqués sont avérés, il y a donc fort à parier que l'appareil devrait coûter moins cher à son lancement, à grands coups d'offres promotionnelles.
Source : AndroidAuthority

articles.title: Cómo instalar Windows 11 sin conexión a internet y sin usar una cuenta Microsoft
articles.text:
Microsoft señala que se necesita conexión a internet para completar la configuración inicial de Windows 11 Home y Pro. Sin embargo, es posible instalar el sistema con una cuenta local mediante un USB preparado con Rufus, una herramienta gratuita que permite personalizar algunos pasos del instalador. El proceso requiere otro equipo conectado para descargar los archivos y crear el USB.
Una cuenta local se crea y se guarda en un solo dispositivo; no necesita internet para iniciar sesión ni sincroniza por defecto archivos y ajustes con otros equipos. Una cuenta Microsoft, en cambio, conecta Windows con servicios como OneDrive, Outlook y Microsoft Store.
Qué necesitas antes de empezar
Prepara una memoria USB vacía de al menos 8 GB y otro ordenador con conexión a internet. Crear el medio de instalación borrará el contenido del USB, así que guarda antes los archivos que quieras conservar.
También necesitarás descargar la imagen ISO oficial de Windows 11 desde Microsoft y Rufus desde su sitio oficial. La página de Microsoft identifica la versión 26H2 como la edición actual y ofrece la descarga de la imagen para crear medios de instalación.
Cómo preparar el USB con Rufus
Conecta la memoria al ordenador y abre Rufus. En el apartado de dispositivo, selecciona el USB correcto; luego elige la imagen ISO de Windows 11 que descargaste y pulsa “Empezar”. Rufus mostrará una ventana de opciones de experiencia de usuario. Activa “Eliminar el requisito de una cuenta Microsoft en línea” y confirma para que el programa cree el medio de instalación.
Rufus también permite configurar la creación de una cuenta local con un nombre elegido durante ese proceso. Revisa con atención las opciones antes de continuar y confirma que seleccionaste la memoria USB correcta: el programa la formateará para grabar los archivos de instalación.
Cómo instalar Windows 11 sin internet
Cuando el USB esté listo, conéctalo al equipo donde instalarás Windows. Reinicia el ordenador y abre el menú de arranque —la tecla depende del fabricante y suele ser F2, F12, Esc o Supr—. Selecciona la memoria USB y sigue las indicaciones para elegir idioma, edición y disco de destino.
Al llegar a la parte de configuración de la cuenta, desconecta el equipo de la red: desenchufa el cable Ethernet y no selecciones una red Wi-Fi. La guía de Rufus explica que la opción preparada en el USB permite recuperar la creación de una cuenta local si el instalador no tiene conexión durante ese paso. Si la computadora sigue conectada, Windows puede volver a pedir una cuenta en línea.
Completa la configuración con el nombre de usuario local y una contraseña, si deseas establecerla. Cuando aparezca el escritorio, puedes conectarte a internet para descargar actualizaciones y controladores. La instalación sin conexión no elimina la necesidad de activar Windows con una licencia válida.
Qué pasa con los métodos de comando
En versiones anteriores se popularizó el comando OOBE\BYPASSNRO para omitir la conexión durante la configuración. Microsoft ha retirado ese archivo de algunas versiones y otras instrucciones también pueden dejar de funcionar según la compilación. Por eso, no conviene presentarlos como una solución universal: el USB preparado con Rufus es una alternativa documentada por el propio proyecto, aunque su disponibilidad puede cambiar con futuras actualizaciones.
Si ya terminaste la instalación con una cuenta Microsoft, también puedes cambiar a una cuenta local desde Configuración > Cuentas > Tu información > Iniciar sesión con una cuenta local en su lugar. Esta opción no evita el requisito inicial de conexión, pero permite dejar de usar la cuenta en línea después de configurar Windows.
Microsoft advierte que, si olvidas la contraseña de una cuenta local, recuperarla puede ser más difícil; por eso recomienda guardar una pista o un método de recuperación seguro.

articles.title: How to choose customer support software for your business
articles.text:
How to choose customer support software for your business
The key considerations for choosing customer support software
Customer support is essential to building a successful business, and software plays a central role in your support operations. Customer support software makes it easy to track customers’ inquiries and respond to them promptly.
Some support requests can be complicated and require many back-and-forth interactions to resolve. Support software ensures your team keeps up with these requests and solves customers’ issues, no matter how tough.
Given its crucial role in your business, customer support software isn’t something to choose lightly. You need to carefully consider the best software, depending on your business type, size, and the complexity of the support requests you handle.
This guide explains what customer support software is, how it works, the key features to look out for, and the core considerations for selecting the best software.
What is customer support software?
Customer support software is the digital tool your business uses to receive, organize, and respond to customer requests.
Think of it as a mail sorting system for your customer inquiries. When a customer sends a request, it’ll be immediately logged into your support system and categorized based on the details. Then, it can be assigned to a specific team or team member based on predefined settings.
Suppose you run an electronics store. Customers would send various types of inquiries, including hardware malfunctions, price requests, setup guidance, and item returns. Handling these requests can be hectic, but support platforms make the process efficient for your team.
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
When someone sends an inquiry, it can be automatically classified based on what they’ve sent. Then, their inquiry can be assigned to a staff or team dedicated to it. For instance, hardware malfunction inquiries can be routed to an in-house expert who handles them.
Support software enables you to aggregate inquiries from various platforms into a single dashboard. Requests sent via email, social media, and online forms can be received and sorted in one place, making the process efficient.
Key features of customer support software
Customer support tools have crucial features that help businesses process inquiries swiftly and keep customers happy. These features include:
Ticket management
The foundation of a support platform is converting customer inquiries into trackable tickets. Every customer inquiry will be converted into a manageable ticket and assigned to the right agent or team, ensuring it isn't lost. Assigning tickets to agents can be done automatically or manually.
This ticketing system should have status updates (“In Progress,” “In Review,” “Closed,” etc.) to keep all team members updated. This way, another support agent can easily continue where their colleague left off with the inquiry. There should also be internal notes for agents to add context to inquiries, helping colleagues understand the nature of the issue.
Knowledge Base
Many customers prefer to resolve issues themselves and only seek help when they are unable to do so personally. Hence, you should offer them a Knowledge Base filled with tutorials, user guides, and answers to frequently asked questions (FAQs).
Advanced support platforms usually have a content management system (CMS) that simplifies Knowledge Base creation. They have professional templates that help you create detailed and simple user guides.
Customers aren’t the only ones who benefit from a Knowledge Base. It also makes your support operations more efficient, as agents can direct customers to specific documents instead of having to repeatedly explain the same steps to different customers.
Live chat
Customers often want speedy answers to their problems. Hence, businesses offer live chat support to deliver speedy resolutions. Customer support platforms provide the infrastructure for seamless live chat between customers and your support agents.
When a customer initiates a live chat request, an available agent can be immediately alerted to respond. After the chat, customers can receive an automated survey to evaluate their support experience.
The most advanced customer support tools incorporate artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots for live chat. These chatbots can respond to mundane requests based on preset commands, freeing up time for your support team to focus on more complex inquiries.
Note that chatbots aren’t a replacement for your support team. Instead, they augment your support agents’ efforts for better productivity.
Security
Support inquiries often involve customers handing over sensitive data that must be protected. Customer support platforms utilize advanced encryption protocols to prevent unauthorized access to data.
Your platform should have role-based control, wherein the administrator decides which data support agents can see or not. For example, you can allow only your finance support team to monitor customers’ transactions, while other teams can’t access this data.
Support platforms keep audit logs for every agent’s interaction with customer data. This way, any leaks can be traced and rectified.
Factors to consider when choosing customer support software
1. Scalability
You likely desire your business to grow over time. Thus, you need software that can scale without causing problems– this factor might seem trivial, but it’s the difference between success and defeat for your support team.
You should be able to add new agents to your support system and have things run smoothly. As your customer base grows, the volume of requests also grows. Hence, your platform should make it easy to upgrade to a higher plan as requests grow.
Most support platforms are cloud-based, so scalability is not much of a concern for businesses. These platforms are often priced per seat, wherein you pay a monthly or annual fee for each support agent in your company. If you hire more support agents, you can create new accounts for them and integrate their work with the existing team.
2. Ease of use
Agents spend all working hours on your support platform. A complex interface can make their work much more difficult and dampen productivity. You need a support platform with an intuitive, easily navigable interface. It should be simple enough for a support agent to master within a short period.
Support platforms offer free trials, so always take advantage of them to test the interface before making a final decision. If it’s overtly difficult for IT administrators to navigate, it’ll be even more difficult for less tech-savvy support agents.
You can run trials with your support team and get their honest opinion – they’re the ones who will spend most time on the software, after all. If their opinions are overwhelmingly negative, it’s a signal to find an alternative platform that won’t cause headaches in the long run.
3. Pricing
Support software is available in all price ranges, from affordable tools priced per agent to custom solutions tailored for large enterprises. You should find one that suits your price point and needs.
Selecting support software involves striking a balance between pricing and the features you desire. Find one that fits within your budget, but remember that the cheapest solution isn’t always the best. Compare prices between different competitors and ensure you get the best deal.
Support platforms for small to medium-sized businesses are priced monthly or annually, based on the number of support agents. Some charge fixed monthly or annual fees per agent, e.g., $10 per agent per month. Others offer monthly packages for a specific number of agents, such as $500 per month for 75 agents.
Platforms designed for large enterprises offer custom pricing. If you represent a large company, you can negotiate directly with the platform’s sales team and snag the best deal.
As mentioned, you should take advantage of free trials to test a support tool before making your final decision. Support platforms usually offer a refund window, ranging from 30 to 60 days, but it’s better to avoid paying for something you don’t like and going through the stress of requesting a refund.
4. Security features
We’ve mentioned security being a core feature of a support platform. Before selecting a support tool, research its security features, including encryption protocols, access controls, backup policies, and compliance with industry standards.
Read reviews and online articles to evaluate a platform’s security history. Your support tool shouldn’t have a history of lax security practices or data breaches.
You also play a major role in keeping your support platform secure. Train support employees on standard security practices, enable multi-factor authentication for all accounts, implement robust access controls, conduct regular security audits, and have a firm plan to respond to security incidents.
5. Support quality
Ironically, a customer support software provider needs to offer excellent support. You should be able to contact them via email, live chat, or telephone and get swift answers.
Support isn’t only about quick responses – the support team should be knowledgeable and willing to help you resolve issues. Often, businesses need help in the initial setup, and the team should be prepared to provide guidance.
You should have access to detailed documentation and a Knowledge Base. When facing issues, you can first consult the Knowledge Base before seeking direct support if that isn’t enough. The free trial presents the best opportunity to test a platform’s support resources before making your final decision.
6. Automation & AI functionalities
Artificial intelligence (AI) is a nascent technology, yet it has made a dent in many software niches, including customer support. You need AI features that help boost your support team’s productivity– not having these features puts you at a competitive disadvantage.
For example, support tools can utilize AI to generate summaries of customer inquiries. Summarizing lengthy tickets saves support agents a considerable amount of time.
Your platform can also use AI to analyze support requests and automatically route them to the relevant agent or team. Likewise, AI can draft responses to mundane customer inquiries, and support agents can make the final edits, saving them time and effort.
AI is a force multiplier for your customer support team, not something you should depend on entirely. Customers can get annoyed if they are mostly directed to chatbots instead of human help.
The idea is to use chatbots to resolve simple inquiries, such as order tracking for an e-commerce business, while support agents focus on more challenging problems.
7. Omnichannel support
Omnichannel support involves managing and responding to customer requests across multiple channels, including social media, email, phone, SMS, and web forms. The best businesses offer omnichannel support to keep customers engaged regardless of how they contact their support team for inquiries. Hence, omnichannel integration should be a core consideration when selecting support software.
Your platform should provide a unified view of all customer inquiries, regardless of the channel from which they originated. This way, agents can view the full history of every request and respond to them from a single dashboard, rather than juggling different tools, which can sap productivity.
While you manage responses from multiple channels, you should be able to measure performance for each channel. For example, you can compare the average ticket resolution times for email requests, live chat, and telephone. This comparison tells you which channel support agents are most productive with, and you can dedicate more resources to that channel.
Final words
Customer support software can make or break a business. Making the right choice helps you build long-term trust and customer loyalty. We’ve explained the core features of a customer support tool and the factors to consider when choosing one. Follow these guidelines to select the best tool for your business and enhance your bottom line.

articles.title: ConnectWise Resets Credentials as Cloud Backup Remains Offline After Security Incident
articles.text:
ConnectWise on Monday said it has taken remediation measures, including strengthening administrative-access protections and resetting accounts and replacing application credentials, as it continues to respond to a security incident that led to unauthorized access to application identities associated with Cloud Backup.
The company said it has completed the following actions since it began rolling out mitigations on October 17 at 5:00 a.m. UTC, three days after the incident was first identified -
- Disabling affected application connections and suspending Cloud Backup.
- Suspending SaaS Security and Cloud Management as a precaution because they are integrated with Cloud Backup.
- Enlisting the help of independent third-party specialists for incident response and remediation.
- Enhancing administrative-access protections.
- Publishing technical guidance to help partners investigate and remediate potential unauthorized activity in their own and managed customer environments.
ConnectWise said it's validating the effectiveness of its containment measures and emphasized that it has not seen any successful threat activity in the environments it monitors. There is no evidence that any ConnectWise products and services, other than Cloud Backup and the precautionary suspensions of SaaS Security and Cloud Management, are impacted.
"This observation does not establish whether individual partner or customer Microsoft 365 tenants have been affected," it said. "Reviewing each potentially affected tenant remains essential."
"Before making changes, preserve relevant evidence, validate findings, and assess potential operational impacts. Completing these steps does not guarantee that a tenant is unaffected or that all unauthorized access has been eliminated. Do not reconnect affected applications until ConnectWise provides formal restoration instructions."
Huntress has shared the following IP addresses observed in connection with the activity, adding that the password spray and failed login attempts linked to some of them are unlikely to be related to the application sign-in activity -
- 144.172.64[.]128 - Application sign-ins with a vendor credential (primary vector)
- 144.172.64[.]99 - Failed user password spray, concentrated (October 10 to 14, 2026)
- 144.172.64[.]60 - A few failed user logins (October 18, 2026)
- 144.172.94[.]243 - Broad failed login spray, ongoing against many organizations
"In a review of application sign-ins across more than 10,000 tenants with ConnectWise applications (where we can see those logs), 144.172.64[.]128 and Microsoft-internal ranges are the only addresses that produced application sign-in activity," Huntress researchers said in an update.
"We did not see application sign-in activity from any of the other addresses listed below, all of which are in the same provider range as 144.172.64[.]128 (AS14956, RouterHosting). We did see password spray and failed login attempts from some of them."
The cybersecurity company said it also observed post-compromise actions on a second tenant, following the same modus operandi as before, in which the application granted itself Global Administrator and then added a new secret on a small number of other applications in the tenant for persistence.
While the access may have been used for Microsoft Graph directory reads, there are no signs the attackers weaponized it for mailbox or file manipulation, or to make user or policy changes.
"The choice of which applications to backdoor appeared to be random in the two tenants we reviewed," Huntress added. "Across the two compromised tenants, the identical grant flow selected two completely different sets of applications. The only consistent criteria we can point to is structural: credentials were planted in applications that are registered inside the affected tenant, without regard to what those applications can actually do."

articles.title: Pillages du 17 octobre : les iPhone et autres smartphones Samsung déjà en train d'être bloqués
articles.text:
Des pilleurs du 17 octobre ont cru pouvoir faire un bon bénéfice avec leurs vols de matériels électroniques. Mais les blocages de ces appareils ont déjà commencé !
Aujourd'hui, les grandes enseignes et plateformes s'organisent pour faire en sorte que les pillages consécutifs aux manifestations du 17 octobre rapportent le moins possible aux délinquants. On a ainsi Leboncoin, Vinted et eBay qui mettent en place une stratégie pour contrer ces reventes. Et du côté des géants comme Apple, on se met à bloquer en masse les appareils volés.
Des iPhone volés le week-end dernier déjà bloqués (avec un petit message menaçant au passage)
Parmi les magasins qui ont été pillés le week-end dernier, on retrouve des Apple Store, comme celui de Lille. Mais les iPhone qui ont été dérobés au passage ne feront pas la fortune des voleurs, comme vous pouvez le voir sur la petite vidéo ci-dessous.
Apple a pu en effet commencer à bloquer les iPhone dérobés, et serait même en train de géolocaliser les appareils. C'est ce qui permet à la marque américaine de pouvoir gentiment intimer l'ordre à l'individu tenant le téléphone volé de rapidement le rapporter là où il devrait être. « Cela vaut aussi pour Samsung, les Google Pixel, ou encore des appareils Xiaomi et Honor » indique une source anonyme de BFM Tech.
Apple a un système particulièrement robuste pour contrer les pillages
Cette action est possible grâce au numéro IMEI (International Mobile Equipment Identity) qui, associé au numéro de série du produit, est envoyé au fabricant, qui peut alors bloquer l'appareil quand il se connecte à internet. Il est par ailleurs ajouté sur une liste noire nationale et internationale, avec, derrière, une plainte qui suite. La justice peut alors exiger une géolocalisation de l'appareil.
À noter que même si le blocage empêche l'appareil de se connecter à un réseau mobile, il peut toujours passer par le Wifi… sauf chez des marques comme Apple. La firme de Cupertino a en effet développé une stratégie anti-pillage au fil des années. Les appareil mis en vitrine sont dans ce cadre dotés d'un système d'exploitation différent, rendant impossible de changer le mot de passe ou d'ajouter un compte iCloud. Une fois connectés au Wifi, il se verrouille, et devient inutilisable. Samsung dispose d'un système similaire avec sa suite Know Mobile Enrollment, capable de verrouiller à distance un modèle d'exposition. De quoi limiter les dégâts ?
Source : L'Indépendant, BFM Tech

articles.title: ‘Self sabotage by Spotify’: The music platform is cracking down on Family plan sharing, and it does nothing except reveal Spotify’s true colors
articles.text:
Spotify’s crack-down on Family plan sharing could land you a 12-month ban, and it could be the final straw for users — myself included
A very narrow definition of 'family'
- Spotify is rolling out a new verification process for Premium Family members
- Users must now scan the account manager's QR code to confirm they're part of the same household
- Spotify will boot you back to the free tier and give you a 12-month Premium Family ban if you fail to verify
The Netflix password-sharing crackdown is rubbing off on one of the best music streaming services — now Spotify is taking its own approach to putting a stop to Premium Family plan sharing.
Spotify is enforcing this via a new QR code verification system, which has started rolling out to a number of users if they’re not at the same address as the account manager. The QR code appears on the account holder’s device, requiring those under the plan to scan it in order to verify that you’re living in the same household. This code updates every few seconds, making it harder for users to use screenshots to bypass the process.
The platform goes into the verification process in detail on its support page, clarifying that it doesn’t use location tracking but instead checks your address to verify it’s the same one as the account manager’s. Additionally, Spotify states that ‘both the manager and member need to be in the same place to complete the scan’.
If you receive a verification prompt, you’ll have a 7-day window to complete the scan, but failure to comply comes with consequences. Spotify will boot you back to ad-listening on the free tier as well as banning you from joining another Premium Family or Duo plan for 12 months. It really does feel like a prison sentence.
As you can imagine, users are beyond frustrated with Spotify’s latest move, and despite not being on the Premium Family plan myself, even I can’t fathom the ridiculousness of it all.
We don’t know if this is region-specific, but a number of users on Reddit have received verification prompts despite there being no formal announcement from the company. ‘Self sabotage by Spotify. If I have to do this more than once for my kids that live at home I'm shutting it down,’ an angry Redditor posted.
One of the many users' frustrations is with, of course, money. By limiting Premium Family as a solely household plan, Spotify will drive a huge number of users out of the grouped plan and leave them with no option but to sign up to Premium Individual.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
This plan is priced at $12.99 / £12.99 / AU$15.99 a month, while Premium Family is $21.99 / £21.99 / AU$25.99 a month and includes up to six individual accounts — which is roughly $3.665 / £3.665 / AU$4.331 per individual account. The more users Spotify can force into Premium Individual accounts, the more subscription revenue it can generate, but it’s so much more than money.
For me, the most ridiculous part is Spotify’s narrow definition of what a ‘family’ is, as a large majority of Premium Family users are members who have moved out of their parents’ home but are still on the same plan — for example, students who move away from home to study. So, in Spotify’s eyes, these types of families are essentially considered lesser than a family whose members still live under the same roof.
Equally, Spotify’s Premium Family plan has been helpful for adults to guide their not-so-tech literate elderly parents through navigating digital streaming, as another Redditor highlights. Someone takes control of the account, sets up a profile for their parents, shows them the ropes, and lets them listen away. Not only does the verification remove this, it also gets rid of the novelty of families comparing their music tastes and reminiscing about their old favourites together.
It has to be said that until now, Spotify has been on its best behavior and even rolled out helpful tools to exclude your kids’ music from your recommendations, which has been welcomed by Premium Family members — but the new verification process just feels like one step forward, three steps back. In that case, Spotify should rebrand Premium Family to 'Premium Household' to avoid confusion.
We’ve reached out to Spotify for further comment, and will update this story if/ when we hear back.
